hero.eyebrow: Sonic Discovery // live in beta · powered by PYXIS-1
hero.title: Find similar tracks [[by sound.]]
hero.sub: Resomix Sonic Discovery is a music similarity search tool that searches by how the music actually sounds. Resomix's PYXIS-1 engine reads the groove, energy, timbre and structure of your reference (drawn from 70+ measurable audio characteristics) and returns a ranked shortlist you can listen to, analyse and develop.

dims.title: What PYXIS-1 listens for
dims.lead: Four of the feature families PYXIS-1 measures, alongside harmony and tonal relationships, drawn from 70+ measurable audio characteristics. Deep per-track anatomy lives in Track Intelligence; here, they decide what belongs next.
dims.d1body: Percussion density, swing and accent placement — the rhythmic signature that determines whether two tracks can be mixed back-to-back, before you ever hear them together.
dims.d1steer: which results feel compatible in motion
dims.d2q: Where does it rise, hold or release?
dims.d2body: The journey of intensity across a track: builds, peaks, breakdowns and resets. Discovery visualises that journey, so you can make more confident decisions for your set or playlist.
dims.d2steer: how the energy of what comes next compares
dims.d3q: What gives it its sonic character?
dims.d3body: The colour and weight of the sound: brightness, density and texture, layered from sub to air. Timbre is why two tracks at the same tempo can feel worlds apart.
dims.d4q: How does it unfold over time?
dims.d4body: Intro, build, drop, break and outro: the phrase-level architecture that gives a track its shape. Track Intelligence reads it section by section.
dims.d4steer: how a track is built, section by section

steps.title: How Resomix Sonic Discovery works, in five steps

items.name: Choose a reference track
items.text: Search for a track in Resomix, or upload your own audio file.

items.name: Resomix analyses the sound
items.text: The PYXIS-1 engine measures rhythm, harmony, timbre, structure and energy, using more than 70 audio characteristics.

items.name: Resomix compares it with the catalogue
items.text: The sound profile is compared with every track Resomix has already analysed.

items.name: Resomix ranks the closest matches
items.text: Tracks are ordered by similarity score, automatically.

items.name: You get a playlist
items.text: Listen to the results, save them, export them, or use any result as your next reference.

items.q: How do I find tracks that sound like a track I already have?
items.a: Search for the track in Resomix, or upload the file, and Sonic Discovery returns a ranked playlist of the closest matches by sound, judged on groove, energy, timbre and structure rather than on genre tags or release date.

items.q: Can I search for music by uploading a file?
items.a: Yes. Upload an MP3, WAV, FLAC or AIFF as your reference. Resomix processes it privately, uses it only as the query, and deletes the source audio no later than 24 hours after upload or analysis.

items.q: Is Sonic Discovery an audio fingerprinting or song-identification tool?
items.a: No. Fingerprinting tells you what a recording is. Resomix tells you what sounds like it, meaning the tracks with the strongest measured sonic relationship to your reference, whoever released them and whenever.

items.q: How does Resomix decide which tracks are similar?
items.a: Resomix's PYXIS-1 engine builds a sonic profile from more than 70 measurable audio characteristics of the whole recording, then compares it with a pre-analysed index. The result is deterministic, so the same reference against the same index returns the same shortlist, each result with its similarity score.

link.label: Why Resomix compares sound, not tags

items.q: Which catalogue does Sonic Discovery search?
items.a: The Resomix catalogue of electronic music, already profiled by PYXIS-1. Partner catalogues are separate and private. See Catalogue Intelligence.

items.q: Can DJs use it to find tracks that mix well together?
items.a: Yes. The shortlist is ranked by groove, energy and structure, and Track Intelligence shows the key, Camelot code and BPM of any result, so you can check compatibility before you play it. The selection stays yours.
